# Meeting workflow

Parliamentary meeting lifecycle (Events workflow): Scheduled → In Progress → Completed, with Postponed and Cancelled branches. Meetings cover House Plenary, committee, administration and other sitting types; agenda and minutes are attached documents and attendance is recorded against a per-meeting register.

```mermaid
%% Generated by `manage.py generate_diagrams`; do not edit by hand.
%% Workflow: Meeting
flowchart TD
    classDef initial fill:#5b6b7f,stroke:#434f5f,color:#FFFFFF,stroke-width:1px
    classDef regular fill:#3c7f52,stroke:#2d5f3e,color:#FFFFFF,stroke-width:1px
    classDef terminal fill:#14532d,stroke:#0d3a20,color:#FFFFFF,stroke-width:1px
    s0(["Scheduled"]):::initial
    s1["In Progress"]:::regular
    s2[["Completed"]]:::terminal
    s3["Postponed"]:::regular
    s4[["Cancelled"]]:::terminal
    s0 -->|"Start meeting"| s1
    s1 -->|"Complete meeting"| s2
    s0 -.->|"Postpone meeting"| s3
    s3 -->|"Reschedule meeting"| s0
    s0 -.->|"Cancel meeting"| s4
    s1 -.->|"Cancel meeting (in progress)"| s4
    s3 -.->|"Cancel meeting (postponed)"| s4
```
